data.title: 美狄亚 · 紫罗兰工坊的魔女幽会
data.action: 优雅倚坐在低矮长榻上，指尖凝结出一只幽紫的魔力蝴蝶，金发挽起露出优美颈项，狭长美眸带着成熟魅惑的浅笑，静静看着步入工坊的丈夫。
data.location: 柳洞寺后山秘密魔术工坊，一侧案台上整齐摆放着未拼装的城堡手办
data.lighting: 指尖魔力蝴蝶散发神秘幽紫冷光，工坊四角的古铜烛台提供跳跃的暖橙底光
data.mood: 神代魔女的成熟高雅、深邃知性与私下对待爱侣的无尽柔情
data.description: 柳洞寺后山秘密魔术工坊，一侧案台上整齐摆放着未拼装的城堡手办。优雅倚坐在低矮长榻上，指尖凝结出一只幽紫的魔力蝴蝶，金发挽起露出优美颈项，狭长美眸带着成熟魅惑的浅笑，静静看着步入工坊的丈夫。 她微微抬眸轻语——“宗一郎大人的品味果然最深得我心……不过今晚，这间魔术工房就只属于你我二人哦。”
data.promptProse: Reclining gracefully on a low divan inside her candlelit secret workshop behind Ryuudou Temple at midnight, Medea wears a deep royal-purple velvet slip dress with a sheer black spiderweb chest panel and gold runic trim. Conjuring a glowing violet magical butterfly above her upturned fingertips beside a workbench holding scrolls and a half-assembled model castle, she gazes affectionately toward her partner in warm bronze candlelight.
data.animaCaption: Seated gracefully in her candlelit temple workshop wearing a deep-purple velvet and sheer black lace slip dress, Medea balances a glowing violet magical butterfly over her fingertips with an affectionate smile. Bronze candelabras illuminate scrolls and her model workbench behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep royal-purple velvet sweetheart slip dress paneled with sheer black spiderweb lace across the chest and edged in gold runic embroidery, baring her shoulders and cleavage.
